Article 11 — Interest. The official English Liechtenstein–Czech Republic treaty provides residence-State-only taxation for interest beneficially owned by a resident of the other Contracting State, subject to the permanent-establishment effective-connection exception and the treaty’s arm’s-length limitation. Article 12 — Royalties. The official English Liechtenstein–Czech Republic treaty provides residence-State-only taxation for copyright royalties relating to literary, artistic or scientific works other than computer programs, including films and broadcast media; and a 10 per cent source-State ceiling for patents, trademarks, designs or models, plans, secret formulae or processes, custom computer software, industrial, commercial or scientific equipment and know-how, where the recipient is the beneficial owner. The permanent-establishment effective-connection exception applies. This is a concise synthesis of the official English treaty text; the official text controls.
